datasets.label_note: LongMemEval-S question_type annotations and BrainBench relational fixtures, mapped to routing labels by gbrain's builder.
gbrain test/fixtures/decide/injection-cases.jsonl: 12 cases, 4 with an attack candidate, labelled by the fixture author.
BrainBench know-to-ask sealed gold from gbrain evals/brainbench (generator-constructed, blind double-labelled by that corpus's own pass); the reflex slice was replayed by the builder.
Know-to-ask reflex-miss corpus from know-to-ask-extra.ts (Mulberry32 seed 60601): the label is the designed intent recorded in know-to-ask-extra/_design.json. No person or model labelled it.
The BrainBench and reflex-miss files concatenated; S6 calibrates on this file.

24 Cat 35 transcripts labelled by that corpus's expected_triage, plus 230 synthetic transcripts from s7-synthetic-transcripts.ts (openai:gpt-5.6-luna) labelled by the generator's instruction (180 routine, 50 with one buried synthesis-worthy passage). Nobody read and labelled them.
datasets.build_command: gbrain decide dataset --slot triage --from cat35 <staged>/s7-triage --out s7-triage.jsonl

datasets.label_note: Claim units from 16 Cat 35 dream pages, labelled supported/unsupported by claude-sonnet-5 (567 real units), plus 183 perturbation negatives written and blind-judged by the same model. LLM labels, not hand labels.
datasets.build_command: (cwd <staged>/s8-root) gbrain decide dataset --slot grounding --from grounding-labels docs/eval/system-one/datasets/s8-grounding/labels.jsonl --out s8.raw.jsonl; then label-source.ts s8.raw.jsonl s8-grounding.jsonl llm:claude-sonnet-5 <labels.jsonl>

datasets.label_note: Fact pairs: 780 from conflict-pairs.ts (Mulberry32 seed 90909) labelled by the template that built them, 6 from labelled gbrain tests. The cosine-rule baseline per pair came from OpenAI text-embedding-3-large at 1536 dimensions.
The S9 pairs whose baseline cosine is at least 0.80, the sweep's candidate floor.

LongMemEval answer-session annotations: label true when the candidate session is one of the question's answer sessions. 20 sessions per question, each capped at 6,000 characters. 57 MB, so it is rebuilt, not committed.
datasets.build_command: gbrain decide dataset --slot evidence --from longmemeval longmemeval_s_cleaned.json --out s3-evidence.jsonl

datasets.label_note: LongMemEval abstention annotations: label false for the 30 _abs questions.
datasets.build_command: gbrain decide dataset --slot answerable --from longmemeval longmemeval_s_cleaned.json --out s4-answerable.jsonl
